tech.summary: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, bringing one of the most popular hosting platforms for open-source AI models, datasets, and tools under the ownership of the world's biggest AI chipmaker.

Google is rolling out an updated AI weather model, WeatherNext 3, which is designed to be more accurate, especially in predicting rain and snowfall, by making forecasts with 'unprecedented resolution'.

As agentic AI moves toward enterprise deployment, the primary challenge is integrating agents to work together, connect to necessary systems and data, and operate safely across business workflows to achieve meaningful scale.

world.summary: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92, with tributes being led by figures such as Hillary Clinton, Nancy Pelosi, and Jill Biden.

An official report from the European court of auditors has concluded that the EU's ability to respond to a foreign invasion by 2030 remains questionable, citing a continued reliance on the US and fragmented national defense systems.
Iran has continued to demonstrate its capability to target US-used bases in the Gulf, with recent drone attacks damaging a residential building in Kuwait City and hitting bases in the UAE and Kuwait.

The Bureau of Meteorology has forecast the strongest El Niño on record, noting that Pacific Ocean temperatures have increased by more than 2 degrees Celsius in six months, indicating an alarming climate change influence.

us.summary: A jury is deadlocked after five days of deliberation in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman charged with murdering her three children.
Millions of children are losing their SNAP food benefits, which directly impacts their eligibility for free school meals, leading experts to observe a breakdown in this critical resource link.
An ICE detainee died just hours after being admitted into government detention, marking the 57th death of an immigrant detainee under government care since the start of President Trump's second term.

science.summary: An investigation by NPR and Boston University found that thousands of heat-related deaths in the United States go officially uncounted each year, suggesting a significant undercount in national statistics.
